resources.string: Install official Termux, open it once, and wait for initialization. Then return here. Keep your existing Termux installation and data.
Android must allow Mochi Termux Extension to run commands in Termux. This does not grant background Shell authorization in Mochi.

Copy the command and open Termux. Wait for initialization, long-press the prompt, paste, and press Enter. MOCHI_SETUP_SAVED means settings were saved, not that connection succeeded. A message such as [1] is only a background job number. Return here for the automatic connection check.
This preserves other settings and allows requests from externally authorized apps, not only Mochi. Android permission is also required. No remote script is downloaded.
The check installs Mochi’s bundled helper in Termux and verifies shell utilities and the callback. It does not run an Agent task or contact a model. Existing setup needs no repeated command.
Installing the bundled helper and checking shell prerequisites and the callback. This may take up to 15 seconds.
No Agent task was submitted. Retry the check or review the one-time Termux setup below.
Android command permission was not granted. Allow it here, or open this extension’s system settings.
No callback arrived within 15 seconds. The cause is unknown; check initialization, external access, and background restrictions.
Termux did not confirm the shell/helper check. Review first-time configuration, then retry. This does not prove which setting is wrong.
Android blocked the background start. Open Termux, then return here to retry.
The Termux command service is unavailable. Open Termux and confirm that initialization has finished.
Android could not open that screen. Check the app is installed and available, then try again.
Open Termux and retry on return

Run unrestricted shell commands with Termux permissions. Commands can read or change Termux files and use the network. Output used by the Agent is sent to your model Provider. No root, SSH server, or overlay permission is required.
Copy setup command and open Termux
